title: Quantum Calibration of Local-Volatility Surfaces from Sparse Option Quotes
abstract: arXiv:2611.25344v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Calibrating a volatility surface from sparse option prices requires repeated solutions of a pricing equation as the volatility parameters change. We implement a hybrid quantum and classical method for this inverse problem using the Dupire local-volatility model. A positive coefficient representation specifies the local variance, and linear combinations of Hamiltonian simulations approximate the associated pricing evolution. The circuit propagates through successive maturity intervals and evaluates discrepancies at the observed strikes. Measurement counts provide the objective values used by a classical optimiser to update the volatility coefficients. We implement this calibration cycle in a logical gate simulator and assess it alongside classical pricing solvers and alternative surface models. translated_title: 基于稀疏期权报价的局部波动率曲面量子校准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.25344v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：从稀疏的期权价格出发校准波动率曲面，需要随着波动率参数的变化反复求解定价方程。我们针对这一逆问题，基于Dupire局部波动率模型实现了一种量子-经典混合方法。通过正系数表示法确定局部方差，并利用哈密顿量模拟的线性组合来近似相应的定价演化。量子线路在连续的到期区间上传播演化，并在观测到的行权价处评估偏差。测量计数提供了目标函数值，供经典优化器用于更新波动率系数。我们在逻辑门模拟器中实现了这一校准循环，并将其与经典定价求解器以及 alternative 曲面模型进行了对比评估。多个到期日的合成算例展示了波动率微笑与偏斜的重构，此外一个小规模线路实验还测试了完整的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于Dupire局部波动率模型与哈密顿量模拟量子线路的量子-经典混合校准方法，能够从稀疏期权报价中重构局部波动率曲面，并在逻辑门模拟器上验证了其对波动率微笑与偏斜的重建能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a hybrid quantum-classical calibration method using the Dupire local-volatility model and Hamiltonian-simulation quantum circuits, enabling reconstruction of local-volatility surfaces from sparse option quotes and demonstrating smile and skew recovery on a logical gate simulator.
